about.description:
This package enables the CONDA_GO_COMPILER environment variable.
This variable is used by conda-forge's patched GoLang compiler to
set conda-aware GOBIN and GOPATH default values. These default
values are ignored if GOBIN and GOPATH environment variables
are set independently by the user.

Futhermore, this package set the correct GOARCH and GOOS
environment variables to enable cross-compilation.
about.summary: The Go (nocgo) compiler activation for conda-build.

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.27.1"

package:
  name: go-${{ go_variant_str }}_${{ cross_target_platform }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # Add a source we don't need so that the bot issues PRs here automatically.
  url: https://dl.google.com/go/go${{ version }}.src.tar.gz
  sha256: 4e408abae126d916b6164627193f2c54f0e3ca1312d693b86db45f862ab238b1

build:
  number: 1
  script:
    file: build
    # Everything that depends on the variant is computed here and written into
    # the etc/conda/env_vars.d JSON file by the build script.
    env:
      GOOS: ${{ GOOS }}
      GOARCH: ${{ GOARCH }}
      CGO_ENABLED: ${{ "1" if go_variant_str == "cgo" else "0" }}
      # Go cannot internally link PIE for linux/riscv64, so -buildmode=pie there
      # requires external (cgo) linking, which is unavailable with CGO_ENABLED=0.
      # Every other nocgo target supports internal PIE linking and keeps it.
      GOFLAGS: ${{ "-modcacherw -trimpath" if go_variant_str == "nocgo" and GOARCH == "riscv64" else "-modcacherw -buildmode=pie -trimpath" }}

requirements:
  run:
    - go ${{ version }}.* ${{ go_variant_str }}_*
  run_exports:
    strong:
      - if: cross_target_platform == "linux-64" and go_variant_str == "cgo"
        then: __glibc >=2.17
    strong_constraints:
      - if: cross_target_platform == "osx-64"
        then: __osx >=10.12

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - etc/conda/env_vars.d/go-${{ go_variant_str }}_${{ cross_target_platform }}.json
        - etc/conda/test-files/**/*
      strict: true
  - script:
      file: ${{ "run_test.sh" if unix else "run_test.bat" }}
      env:
        build_platform: ${{ build_platform }}
        cross_target_platform: ${{ cross_target_platform }}
    files:
      recipe:
        - hello_world.go
    requirements:
      run:
        # linux/riscv64 has no internal PIE linking, so -buildmode=pie falls back to
        # external linking and needs a real cross compiler to provide $CC. This is
        # named explicitly rather than via compiler('c'), which would resolve against
        # target_platform (the build platform) instead of cross_target_platform.
        - if: go_variant_str == "cgo" and cross_target_platform == "linux-riscv64"
          then: gcc_linux-riscv64

about:
  homepage: https://golang.org
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: The Go (${{ go_variant_str }}) compiler activation for conda-build.
  description: |
    This package enables the CONDA_GO_COMPILER environment variable.
    This variable is used by conda-forge's patched GoLang compiler to
    set conda-aware GOBIN and GOPATH default values. These default
    values are ignored if GOBIN and GOPATH environment variables
    are set independently by the user.

    Futhermore, this package set the correct GOARCH and GOOS
    environment variables to enable cross-compilation.
  documentation: https://golang.org/doc
  repository: https://go.googlesource.com/go

extra:
  feedstock-name: go-activation
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/go
